scripts.test: npm run db:up && npm test -w be && npm test -w fe && npm run build -w fe && npm run test:py
scripts.test:py: cross-env GEMINI_API_KEY=test-key NGROK_AUTHTOKEN=test-token python -m unittest discover -s be/rag -p "*_test.py" && cross-env GEMINI_API_KEY=test-key NGROK_AUTHTOKEN=test-token python -m unittest discover -s e2e/py -t e2e/py -p "*_test.py"
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n be,fe -c blue,green "npm run dev -w be" "npm run dev -w fe"
